interacts_with_supplements.note: Both lower blood sugar. Combined use may cause hypoglycemia.
Both improve insulin sensitivity. Monitor blood sugar closely.

Metformin.monitoring_note: Check B12 and folate annually. Watch for numbness/tingling (neuropathy from B12 depletion).

interacts_with_supplements.note: Statins deplete CoQ10. Supplementing 100-200mg CoQ10 recommended.
Complementary lipid-lowering effects. Safe combination.
Both lower LDL. Combined effect may be too aggressive.
Curcumin may enhance statin absorption. Monitor liver enzymes.

Atorvastatin.monitoring_note: Check liver enzymes (ALT, AST) and lipid panel every 6-12 months.

interacts_with_supplements.note: Iron reduces levothyroxine absorption. Separate by 4+ hours.
Calcium reduces absorption. Separate by 4+ hours.
Magnesium reduces absorption. Separate by 4+ hours.
Selenium supports T4 to T3 conversion. May improve thyroid function.

Levothyroxine.monitoring_note: Take on empty stomach 30-60 min before food. Check TSH every 6-8 weeks after dose changes.

interacts_with_supplements.note: ACE inhibitors deplete zinc. Consider supplementing 15-30mg.
May enhance blood pressure lowering. Monitor BP.

Lisinopril.monitoring_note: Monitor potassium and kidney function (creatinine, BUN). Avoid potassium supplements.

interacts_with_supplements.note: PPIs reduce B12 absorption. Use sublingual or injection form.
Long-term PPI use depletes magnesium. Supplement recommended.
Reduced stomach acid impairs iron absorption. Take iron separately.
PPIs alter gut microbiome. Probiotics may help maintain balance.

Omeprazole.monitoring_note: Check B12 and magnesium annually with long-term use. Consider periodic taper attempts.

interacts_with_supplements.note: May enhance blood pressure lowering. Monitor BP.

Losartan.monitoring_note: Monitor potassium and kidney function. Losartan uniquely lowers uric acid among ARBs.

interacts_with_supplements.note: Additive blood pressure lowering. Monitor BP when starting magnesium.

Amlodipine.monitoring_note: Check blood pressure regularly. Watch for ankle swelling (common side effect).

interacts_with_supplements.note: Both affect serotonin. Use caution and discuss with provider.
L-Theanine may complement SSRI effects for anxiety. Generally safe.
Omega-3 may enhance antidepressant effects. Well-studied combination.

Sertraline.monitoring_note: Monitor mood and side effects. Weight, sleep, and libido changes are common.

interacts_with_supplements.note: Both have antiplatelet effects. May increase bleeding risk at high omega-3 doses.
Aspirin depletes vitamin C. Consider supplementing.
Both thin blood. Combined use may increase bleeding risk.

Aspirin.monitoring_note: Monitor for GI bleeding signs. Check CBC annually.

interacts_with_supplements.note: Do not take OTC D3 while on prescription D3 without provider guidance.
K2 directs calcium to bones, important with high-dose D3.
High-dose D3 increases calcium absorption. Monitor serum calcium.

Vitamin D3 (Rx).monitoring_note: Recheck 25(OH)D in 8-12 weeks. Watch for hypercalcemia symptoms.

interacts_with_supplements.note: Steroids accelerate bone loss. Calcium + D3 + K2 recommended.
Steroids impair vitamin D metabolism. Higher D3 doses often needed.
Steroids deplete zinc. Consider supplementing.
Both affect blood sugar. Steroids raise glucose; berberine lowers it.

Prednisone.monitoring_note: Monitor blood sugar, bone density, potassium, and adrenal function with prolonged use.

interacts_with_supplements.note: Beta-blockers deplete CoQ10. Consider supplementing 100-200mg.
Beta-blockers suppress melatonin production. Low-dose melatonin may help sleep.
Both lower heart rate. Monitor for excessive bradycardia.

Metoprolol.monitoring_note: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure. Check lipid panel periodically.
